name: events
title: Events
summary: People create events with a time and place, RSVP with a waitlist when full, get reminders and cancellation notices, and add events to their calendar.

env.name: EVENTS_REMINDER_OFFSETS
env.doc: When reminders go out before an event starts: comma-separated Go durations between 1m and 720h. Each person gets each reminder once; a bad entry fails the boot.

wire.insert: import { eventsAdminNav, eventsHomeTile, eventsNav, eventsSettings } from "./events/registry";

stitch: Decide who may create events. Default: any active signed-in person. Restrict it (staff, org admins) in createHandler if the product needs it.
Decide the default visibility for new events (members) and where public events are linked from; /e/<id> is the signed-out page (wired into proxy.ts public paths).
Give hosts a people picker for co-hosts and invites (both take user ids), or rely on the invite link.
Set EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL so mobile invite links are web URLs (they fall back to <scheme>:// app links without it).
Make event_cover/ public-read in the bucket policy.
Mobile: @react-native-community/datetimepicker is a native module; rebuild the dev client after installing.
